## Brief

Words only: the user has a fingerpicked melody already and wants a folk lyric about leaving a small island on the last ferry of the season. The narrator is a seasonal worker, not a tourist; the leaving is routine, not tragic. Verses should stay concrete (timetables, shuttered shops, boots left behind) and the chorus should work as a refrain the whole boat could sing. No chords or melody are requested.
